name: TC-RENEWAL-014: Search Renewal Lead Listing by Copied Subscription ID
description: Search by Subscription ID in the listing search bar under 'All' tab and assert filtered record appears.
descriptionHtml: Search by Subscription ID in the listing search bar under 'All' tab and assert filtered record appears.

steps.name: Class Setup: Authenticate & Initialize Renewal Session

testStage.description: Search by Subscription ID in the listing search bar under 'All' tab and assert filtered record appears.

steps.name: 1. Switch to 'All' Tab to Include Updated Lead
2. Enter Subscription ID '1121096618' into Listing Search Bar
3. Assert Table Filters to Show Subscription ID: '1121096618'
4. Scan for Errors on Search Results
